sourceNotes.rawContent: Celebrate an unbreakable bond with this stunning Interlocking Double Heart Bracelet. Featuring a shimmering crystal-studded heart joined with a polished gold-toned heart, this high-fashion piece adds instant romance to any look. To maintain its radiant glow, keep it dry and away from perfumes, storing it safely after each wear.

notes: category: "bracelets" is a PROPOSAL, not source data — the source had no category. Basis: the title and description both describe the piece as a bracelet, and the original category label was "Bracelet under ₹99". Requires explicit owner confirmation at review.
